name: Marisol Fenn
text: I once got locked inside a bakery after closing. I didn't call anyone for an hour because I was busy eating croissants.

name: Juniper Vale
text: At my cousin's wedding I caught the bouquet, the garter and a runaway goose. Only the goose was planned by nobody.

name: Ravi Thistle
text: I was an extra in a cereal commercial. My only line was 'Crunchy!' and they still dubbed it over.

name: Gus Moreau
text: I accidentally joined a stranger's family reunion and stayed for the three-legged race. We came second.

name: Otto Brisket
text: I have a certificate saying I'm the regional champion of competitive napping. There were four entrants and I was the only one who fell asleep.

name: Pip Calloway
text: I named my first car Gerald. When Gerald broke down, the tow truck driver was also called Gerald.

name: Bea Lindqvist
text: I taught a parrot to say 'Is that a new haircut?' It now lives with my aunt and compliments every visitor.

name: Dez Okonkwo-Hart
text: I once returned a library book 11 years late. The librarian waived the fine because the book was about procrastination.
